sentence: Every theme restates in the model's terms -- R01/P01 for the start and calls, P02/P04 for the design and template, P03/P14 for building and machine hands, P05 for guarding, P08/P16/P07 for neighbour space and help, P09/P18 plus the standing claim C02 for the pre-canvas band-rivalry attacks, P20 for the sub's line around canvas talk, K01 for the April-Fools pranks, and P11/P12/P13 for marking, recording and keeping -- and none of the unused concepts shows organizing the model lacks or contradicts.
